newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia vehicle sales rise 10.9 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Colombia vehicle sales rise 10.9 pct in January.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Colombia rose 10.9 percent in January 1997 to 9,150 compared with 8,251 sales in the same month of 1996, industry sources said Monday.
Car sales rose 13.2 percent to 5,884, while trucks and commercial vehicle sales grew seven percent to 3,266, according to figures drawn up by Colombia's three main vehicle assembly plants.
South Korean conglomerate Daewoo saw sales of its vehicles more than double to 607, while local Mazda Motor assembler Compania Colombiana Automotriz saw its sales grow 27.7 percent to 1,148.
Sales of Chevrolet, assembled by General Motors-Colmotores, grew 1.2 percent to 3,166, while Renault assembler Sociedad de Fabricacion de Automotores SA (Sofasa) saw sales fall 8.2 percent to 1,215.
